title: Sindh Local Government Second Amendment Act 1989

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Local Government Second Amendment Act 1989
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT III OF 1990
ACT III OF 1990
SINDH LOCAL
GOVERNMENT (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1989
An Act to amend
the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 16th January, 1990]
No.PAS/Legis-B-15/89, dated
16-1-1990.--The Sindh Local Government (Second Amendment) Bill, 1989 having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 4th December, 1989 and
assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 4th January, 1990 is hereby published
as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1)
This Act may be called the Sindh Local Government (Second Amendment) Act, 1989.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.description:
Amendment of section 14 of Sindh Ordinance (XII of 1979)

ACT III OF 1990
ACT III OF 1990
SINDH LOCAL
GOVERNMENT (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1989
An Act to amend
the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 16th January, 1990]
No.PAS/Legis-B-15/89, dated
16-1-1990.--The Sindh Local Government (Second Amendment) Bill, 1989 having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 4th December, 1989 and
assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 4th January, 1990 is hereby published
as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
2. Amendment of section 14 of
Sindh Ordinance (XII of 1979)--In the Sindh Local Government Ordinance,
1979, hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 14, in
subsection (1), in clause (b), the full-stop at the end shall be replaced by a
semi-colon and thereafter the following proviso shall be added:--
"Provided that a person
other than a woman who contested election but lost on a general scat shall not
be eligible to contest election under this clause.

"involving moral turpitude" shall be inserted.
